segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Configure the recurring date. var dateComponents = DateComponents() dateComponents.calendar = Calendar.current dateComponents.weekday = 3 // Tuesday dateComponents.hour = 14 // 14:00 hours // Create the trigger as a repeating event. let trigger = UNCalendarNotificationTrigger( dateMatching: dateComponents, repeats: true) ```
